record.paper_title: Homogeneous manifolds whose geodesics are orbits. Recent results and some open problems
record.original_question: For generalized Wallach spaces of type 2 or type 3 with invariant metrics determined by positive parameters (lambda_1,lambda_2,lambda_3), where at least two parameters are different, determine all homogeneous geodesics by solving or otherwise characterizing the system of dim(m_1)+dim(m_2)+dim(m_3) quadratic equations for geodesic vectors. A generalized Wallach space is a compact homogeneous space G/K whose tangent module m decomposes as m_1+m_2+m_3 into three Ad(K)-invariant irreducible modules that are pairwise orthogonal with respect to the negative Killing form and satisfy [m_i,m_i] contained in k.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G/K be a compact homogeneous space with reductive decomposition g = k ⊕ m. Assume that the tangent module m decomposes as an orthogonal (with respect to the negative of the Killing form B of g) direct sum

  m = m_1 ⊕ m_2 ⊕ m_3

of three Ad(K)-invariant irreducible submodules satisfying [m_i, m_i] ⊆ k for i = 1, 2, 3. Such a space is called a generalized Wallach space. For positive parameters λ_1, λ_2, λ_3 > 0, consider the G-invariant Riemannian metric on G/K corresponding to the inner product

  ⟨ , ⟩ = λ_1 (−B)|_{m_1} + λ_2 (−B)|_{m_2} + λ_3 (−B)|_{m_3}.

A nonzero vector X ∈ m is called a geodesic vector if the curve γ(t) = exp(tX) · o is a geodesic of (G/K, ⟨ , ⟩); equivalently, ⟨[X, Y]_m, X⟩ = 0 for all Y ∈ m, where [·,·]_m denotes the m-component.

A generalized Wallach space is said to be of type 2 if exactly two of the structure constants
  a_i = (1/d_i) ∑ B([e^i_α, e^j_β], [e^i_α, e^k_γ])  (for {i,j,k} = {1,2,3})
coincide, and of type 3 if all three are distinct.

Problem: For every generalized Wallach space of type 2 or type 3, and for every choice of positive parameters (λ_1, λ_2, λ_3) with at least two of the λ_i distinct, determine all geodesic vectors X = X_1 + X_2 + X_3 ∈ m (X_i ∈ m_i) by solving, or otherwise explicitly characterizing the solution set of, the corresponding system of dim(m_1) + dim(m_2) + dim(m_3) quadratic equations expressing the geodesic vector condition.
artifact.category_tag: Homogeneous geodesics on generalized Wallach spaces
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of explicitly determining all homogeneous geodesics on generalized Wallach spaces of types 2 and 3 with arbitrary invariant metric parameters appears to remain open. While the classification of generalized Wallach spaces that are g.o. spaces (i.e., where all geodesics are homogeneous) has been carried out, and homogeneous geodesics have been studied in particular examples such as SU(2) and the Stiefel manifold SO(4)/SO(2), no general solution of the full system of quadratic equations for geodesic vectors in the type 2 / type 3 cases with generic positive (λ_1, λ_2, λ_3) is reported in the literature; the problem is described as not easy in general.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous Geodesics in Generalized Wallach Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Homogeneous geodesics can be found through explicit computations, with examples including SU(2) and the Stiefel manifold SO(4)/SO(2).
status_evidence.claim: Existing work treats only special examples rather than a full general solution.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous manifolds whose geodesics are orbits
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of generalized Wallach spaces which are g.o. spaces; general determination of geodesic vectors in types 2 and 3 listed among open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The general determination remains an open problem.
